title: US Company Gives Over 18,000 Kilograms of Salmon to Food Bank
titleZh: 美国公司向食品银行捐赠超过1.8万公斤三文鱼
credits: Michael Hill reported on this story for the Associated Press. John Russell adapted it for VOA Learning English.

sentences.en: A New York food bank was offered a large donation of fresh fish last month — but the gift came with a complication.
sentences.zh: 上个月，纽约一家食物银行收到了一份大额的新鲜鱼类捐赠——但这份礼物却带来了一个难题。

sentences.en: LocalCoho, a New York salmon farm that was closing, wanted to give 18,100 kilograms of coho salmon to the Food Bank of Central New York.
sentences.zh: 一家即将关闭的纽约三文鱼养殖场LocalCoho，打算向纽约中部食物银行捐赠1.81万公斤银鲑。

sentences.en: The high-quality protein could feed thousands of families.
sentences.zh: 这种高蛋白食物足以养活成千上万个家庭。

sentences.en: However, the gift fish were still alive and swimming in the farm’s large tanks.
sentences.zh: 然而，这批作为礼物的鱼还活着，在养殖场的大型水箱里游动。

sentences.en: The organization needed to find a way to remove about 13,000 salmon from the tanks and, later, process them into food.
sentences.zh: 该机构需要想办法从水箱中捞出约1.3万条三文鱼，随后再将它们加工成食品。

sentences.en: And the food aid group needed to do all this quickly, before the business closed permanently at the end of January.
sentences.zh: 而且，这食物援助机构必须在1月底该企业永久关闭之前，尽快完成这一切。

sentences.en: Thanks to many volunteers, the group was able to empty the tanks in time, place the fish in cold storage and transport them to a processer.
sentences.zh: 多亏了众多志愿者的帮助，该机构得以及时清空水箱，将鱼放入冷库，并运往加工厂。

sentences.en: Brian McManus is the food bank’s chief operations officer.
sentences.zh: 布莱恩·曼努斯是这家食物银行的首席运营官。

sentences.en: He said that the short amount of time to complete the operation made activities difficult.
sentences.zh: 他表示，完成这项操作的时间非常短暂，给各项工作带来了困难。

sentences.en: But, he said, “I knew that we had the will.
sentences.zh: 但是，他表示，"我知道我们有意志。"

sentences.en: I knew we had the expertise.”
sentences.zh: 我知道我们具备这方面的专业能力。

sentences.en: Food waste has been a big problem around the world for years.
sentences.zh: 多年来，食物浪费已成为全球面临的一个重大问题。

sentences.en: More than one-third of the food produced in the United States is never eaten and much of it ends up in landfills.
sentences.zh: 美国生产的食物中有超过三分之一从未被食用，其中很多最终被填埋处理。

sentences.en: Christina Hudson Kohler was among the volunteers who got into the water to collect the fish and put them into the cold storage containers.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂娜·哈德森·科勒是那些下水收集鱼类并将其放入冷藏容器中的志愿者之一。

sentences.en: “It’s a little bit different,” Kohler said during a break.
sentences.zh: 科勒在一次休息时说：'这有点不一样。'

sentences.en: “In the past, my volunteer work with the food bank has been sorting carrots or peppers….”
sentences.zh: '过去，我在食物银行做的志愿工作一直是分拣胡萝卜或辣椒……'

sentences.en: LocalCoho was a new company that had been developing a sustainable salmon farming system.
sentences.zh: LocalCoho是一家新公司，一直在研发可持续的三文鱼养殖系统。

sentences.en: The system employed recirculated water.
sentences.zh: 该系统采用了循环用水技术。

sentences.en: The company had been supplying coho salmon to buyers, including restaurants, with the goal of building farms across the country.
sentences.zh: 这家公司一直向包括餐厅在内的买家供应银鲑 salmon，目标是在全国范围内建立养殖场。

sentences.en: But company officials said they could not raise enough money from investors to grow and become profitable.
sentences.zh: 但公司官员表示，他们无法从投资者那里筹集到足够的资金来扩大规模并实现盈利。

sentences.en: So, they decided to close the business.
sentences.zh: 于是，他们决定关闭这家企业。

sentences.en: Adam Kramarsyck was the salmon farm’s manager.
sentences.zh: 亚当·克拉马尔斯伊克是这座鲑鱼养殖场的经理。

sentences.en: He said the company did not want the fish to go to waste so it sought a way to donate them.
sentences.zh: 他表示，公司不希望这些鱼被浪费，于是想办法将它们捐赠出去。

sentences.en: Kramarsyck said of the effort, “It’s ‘lemonade out of lemons.’” The expression means to create good from a bad situation.
sentences.zh: 克拉马尔斯伊克这样评价这项善举：'这是'化苦为甜'。'这句话的意思是从糟糕的处境中创造出好的结果。

sentences.en: The donation is expected to provide more than 26,000 servings of hard-to-source protein for the hungry.
sentences.zh: 此次捐赠预计能为饥饿的人们提供超过2.6万份难以获取的蛋白质。

sentences.en: “Protein, animal protein is very, very desirable.
sentences.zh: '蛋白质，尤其是动物性蛋白质，非常非常宝贵。

sentences.en: We know that people need it for nourishment and it’s difficult to get.
sentences.zh: 我们知道人们需要它来补充营养，而且很难获得。

sentences.en: And so this is going to make a very large impact," said McManus, the food bank chief.
sentences.zh: 所以这将产生非常大的影响。'食物银行负责人麦克曼纳斯说。

sentences.en: “I don’t anticipate this being here very long,'' he added.
sentences.zh: '我预计这些东西不会在这里停留太久，'他补充道。

sentences.en: "We’ve had salmon before, but not like this.”
sentences.zh: '我们以前也收到过鲑鱼，但像这样的还是头一次。'

sentences.en: I'm John Russell.
sentences.zh: 我是约翰·罗素。
